Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Mali – Repatriation of Africans returned from Guinea: the government mobilizes logistical resources
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 7 (AMAP) The Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, chaired an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC) on Saturday, devoted to the care of nationals of six nationalities returned from gold mining areas in Guinea, according to a statement from the Prime Minister's Office As part of this African solidarity operation, Mali mobilized 74 trucks and 21 buses.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Bla: The National Defense Forces repels a terrorist attack at the checkpoint
Mali.summary: Bla, November 7 (AMAP) The Bla checkpoint, located Ségou – Bla road, was attacked Friday around 4:45 PM, by armed terrorist groups, causing many deaths and injuries of occult forces and one death and injuries on the side of the FAMa, learned AMAP from local source According to the first testimonies collected from the agents on duty on the spot, the assailants came in number of 32, including 2 by motorcycle 16 motorcycles, opened fire without warning on the elements posted at the control.

Mali.title: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: from the return of the FAMa...
Mali.summary: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: from the return of the FAMa to the Algiers-Abou Dhabi rivalry, is the Sahel entering a new sequence? The entry of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) into Kidal unquestionably marks a major political and military turning point . It enshrines the restoration of a symbol of state authority, modifies the balance of power in the North and shakes up the speeches that, in April, presented the situation as a sign of an irreversible failure of Mali.

Mali.title: Assessment of the military operations of the Fama of mid-September 2026: The Dirpa reports 4880 fighters...
Mali.summary: Review of the military operations of the Fama of mid-September 2026: Dirpa reports 4,880 neutralized fighters and more than 162 bases destroyed During its traditional press briefing, held on Friday, October 23, 2026, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (Dirpa) presented the review of the operations conducted by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) between May and September 2026 According to its director, Colonel-Major Boubacar Bocar Maiga, the operations made it possible to neutralize more than 4,880 fighters of the armed groups and to destroy more than 162 bases.

Burkina Faso.title: Behind the lull, the war continues in Burkina Faso
Burkina Faso.summary: Since July, Burkina Faso has recorded a dramatic decline in the number of deaths related to jihadist violence. The military power sees this as confirmation of its security strategy. Yet attacks persist, armed groups retain their ability to harm and civilian populations remain exposed to a war far from over .

Niger.title: Report: Algeria's Military Deployment in Niger Redraws Lines of Rivalry with Morocco and Rift in Sahel
Niger.summary: London - “Al-Quds Al-Arabi”: The Cradle published an analytical report entitled “Algeria's Military Deployment in Niger Redraws Fault Lines in the Coast” by Aidan J. Simardon provided an analysis of Algeria's historic move with the military deployment in Niger, the backgrounds of this shift in Algerian foreign policy, and its objectives related to security and the struggle for regional influence Algeria's first declared overseas land deployment since the 1973 war represents a broader conflict over the security of the Sahel, Moroccan influence, and control of energy corridors in Africa.

Niger.title: An Algerian diplomat responds to the European Union on the deployment of the army in Niger.. What is the story?
Niger.summary: An Algerian diplomat responds to the European Union on the deployment of the army in Niger. What is the story?

Niger.title: Dosso: New soldiers of the 2025 contingent of the Agali Training and Education Center presented to the flag
Niger.summary: Dosso, 6 November (ANP) – The Dosso Training Centre (CIE) hosted this Friday, 6 November 2026, a solemn ceremony of presentation to the national flag of the soldiers of contingent 2025 This major event took place in the presence of many military, administrative, customary and religious authorities of the region, testifying to the importance given to the training and engagement of young recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN) .

Niger.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Niger.title: Niafunké: Two kamikaze drones miss their targets, FAMa reaction welcomed
Niger.summary: Niafunké, November 5 (AMAP)– Two kamikaze drones launched from the south of Niafunké, across the Niger River, in the direction of the city, missed their targets on Thursday. The incident resulted in a minor injury, immediately taken care of by the Defence and Security Forces (FDS), the AMAP learned from a security source . According to the information gathered, one of the machines fell into the rice fields of the Goubo rice field, while the second crashed into the concession of a resident, damaging his solar installations.
